title: LINE, 3DFACE, 3DLINE, SOLID, TRACE, POINT, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, TEXT, and SHAPE DXF writer revision transaction matrix
scope: Generated direct-writer transaction and library self-readback controls for LINE, 3DFACE, 3DLINE, SOLID, TRACE, POINT, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, TEXT, and SHAPE.

3DFACE.geometry: Four distinct WCS corners and selected invisible-edge flags.

3DLINE.geometry: Distinct 3D endpoints, non-default extrusion and thickness; AC1014 is excluded by the writer's minimum-version gate.

SOLID.geometry: Four WCS corners at a shared elevation, non-default extrusion and thickness.

TRACE.geometry: Four WCS corners at a shared elevation, non-default extrusion and thickness.

POINT.geometry: Non-default position, thickness, extrusion and UCS angle.

CIRCLE.geometry: Non-default center, elevation, radius and thickness.

ARC.geometry: Non-default center, elevation, radius, thickness and partial sweep angles.

ELLIPSE.geometry: Partial ellipse with non-default center, major axis, ratio and parameters. AC1009 uses the configured eight-part R12 conversion and typed polyline carrier readback; AC1014+ retain the typed ELLIPSE.

TEXT.geometry_and_fields: Non-default insertion/alignment positions, text payload, style, height, width, oblique and angle; AC1009 exercises uppercase style output.

SHAPE.geometry_and_fields: Non-default insertion point, scale, SHX style name, rotation, width factor, oblique, thickness and extrusion.

checks: Every injected allocation failure fails the enclosing write while preserving the prior destination bytes and caller entity fields.
Every failed cell retries through the same codec and reproduces the clean reference bytes.
Fresh dx_iface fileImport readback checks source revision, typed entity subtype and all profiled geometry fields.
The generated test removes its DXF outputs; no fixture files were added.
verification.direct_result: PASS, 158 profile/encoding cells, 1493 injected allocation failures

limitations: Locally generated writer and self-readback evidence only; paired implementation behavior is not independent format proof.
Does not qualify physical producer profiles, native application behavior, or 3D geometry semantics.
